answer: Sybil rings betray their shape. A cluster forged for votes links tightly inward and barely outward, so the ledger runs spectral cuts across the interaction graph and collapses any partition that moves like one body. Like a gale over the ocean, coordinated ripples reveal a single wind; one honest sparrow, woven into years of messy, independent friendships, survives the cut. Forgers must then buy real history, not just wallets.
